title: Android Developer
description:
LinqOps is a fast\-growing SaaS platform for Amazon Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), built by people who run a DSP. Around 4,000 daily active users across multiple time zones rely on our platform to run their delivery operations, from fleet and payroll compliance to driver tracking, hiring, and daily dispatch.
 



 We're now building a native Android app so drivers and field teams can stay connected in real time while they're on the road. We're looking for an Android Developer to own that app from the ground up.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 



 • Build and own our native Android app, from architecture to Play Store release
 



 • Build real\-time features: push notifications, background services, and in\-app audio
 



 • Make the app reliable on devices used all day in the field, with poor connectivity, battery constraints, and hands\-busy use
 



 • Integrate with our TypeScript backend APIs and event\-driven platform
 



 • Ship features end to end, then improve them based on feedback from drivers and DSP owners
 



 • Collaborate with a distributed product, engineering, and operations team across India and the US
 



  





 TECH STACK
 



 • Kotlin and native Android (Jetpack)
 



 • Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
 



 • Backend: TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL
 



 • Cloud: AWS, GCP, SST
 



 • Event\-driven architecture
 



  





 MUST\-HAVES
 



 • 3\+ years of native Android development in Kotlin
 



 • At least one production app published on the Google Play Store
 



 • Strong experience with foreground services, background work, and Android lifecycle and battery constraints (Doze, app standby)
 



 • Hands\-on experience with FCM push notifications
 



 • Experience consuming REST APIs and handling authentication securely
 



 • Comfort working independently in a fast\-paced startup environment
 



 • Clear written English for async collaboration
 



 • Availability to work approx. 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST
 



  





 PREFERRED
 



 • Experience with audio recording and playback (MediaRecorder, ExoPlayer/Media3, audio focus, codecs such as Opus)
 



 • Experience with real\-time or voice communication apps
 



 • Jetpack Compose
 



 • Experience with enterprise device management (MDM) or rugged Android devices
 



 • Offline\-first design and sync
 



 • Familiarity with TypeScript or backend development
 



 • Background in logistics, fleet, or field\-workforce apps
 



  





 ENGAGEMENT
 



 • Compensation: ₹10–16 LPA, based on experience and skill set
 



 • Contract\-to\-hire: we start with a contract role, and the goal is a full\-time offer for strong performers who are interested and available
 



 • Location: 100% remote, India
 



 • Working hours: approx. 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST, overlapping with US Eastern business hours
 



  





 WHY JOIN US
 



 • Own a new product from day one and see drivers use it every day
 



 • Solve hard mobile problems: real\-time delivery, reliability, and hands\-free use
 



 • Startup pace with real ownership and fast feedback loops
 



 • A clear path to grow as we expand the team and our customer base
 


* • Work with a distributed team that includes experienced engineering leaders and DSP operators

title: SAP Consultant
description:

title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Web Application \& Software Engineering**
* Architect \& Build Applications: Design, develop, and deploy responsive, high\-performance web applications using modern full\-stack frameworks (e.g., MERN, MEAN, LAMP, or Java/Spring Boot).
* API Development \& Integration: Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front\-end interfaces, back\-end systems, and third\-party tools.
* Database Management: Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non\-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high\-throughput, enterprise\-scale applications.


**Data Engineering \& Business Intelligence**
* ETL \& Data Pipeline Design: Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third\-party APIs.
* Dashboard \& Analytics Engineering: Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision\-making.
* Data Modeling \& Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.


**Enterprise Process Automation**
* Workflow Automation: Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end\-to\-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
* System Integration: Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.


**AI \& Emerging Technology Integration**
* Generative \& Agentic AI Solutions: Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
* AI Tooling \& Prompt Engineering: Build AI\-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.


**Cloud \& DevOps Operations**
* Cloud Architecture: Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
* CI/CD \& Code Hygiene: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.


**Qualifications**
**Key Skill Requirements**
**Hands\-on Experience**
* 4 to 8 years of core hands\-on experience in full\-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.


**Software \& Web Development Stack**
* Proficiency in at least one primary full\-stack development technology suite:
+ MERN / MEAN: React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
+ Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
+ LAMP / Web: PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**
* Experience in designing ETL/ELT processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
* Proficiency with both SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.


**Process Automation**
* Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud \& Desktop flows).


**Cloud Platforms**
* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.


**Teamwork, Communication \& Execution**
* Collaboration \& Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi\-disciplinary \& multi\-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
* Interpersonal \& Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non\-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
* Action\-Oriented \& Proactive: Highly self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.


**Preferred Experience**
* Generative \& Agentic AI:
+ Understanding of LLM/SLM fine\-tuning, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
+ Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function\-calling protocols.

* DevOps \& Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
* Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross\-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
* Problem\-Solving \& Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Primary Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
* Certifications (Desirable):
+ Cloud: Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
+ Analytics \& Automation: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL\-100/PL\-400\).

description:
**IoT Engineer – Telematics \& C\#/.NET**
 Experience :05\+ Years
   

  

 Location : Ahmedabad
   

  

**About Myfms**
 MyFMS is Micpoint B.V.'s SaaS platform for fleet, facility, and access management, built on .NET and C\#, and hosted on our own private cloud in the Netherlands, spread across two data centers. A key part of MyFMS is its connector layer: the software that links telematics and IoT hardware in the field (such as GPS trackers and CAN\-bus interfaces) to the platform. To further build out and standardize this layer, we're looking for an IoT Engineer with C\#/.NET development experience.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Implement and maintain telematics integrations in C\#/.NET on MyFMS's connectors, which link telematics hardware (e.g. GPS trackers and CAN\-bus interfaces) to the platform.
* Investigate which configurations, protocol settings, and command sets of supported hardware (e.g. CAN/LVCAN parameters) can serve as a standard, and document them.
* Research and manage firmware versions for telematics devices, and advise on firmware updates and compatibility.
* Translate device\-specific protocols into a uniform, reusable data structure within the platform.
* Document device configurations and firmware standards in Markdown for the development team and support organization.
* Work according to our DevOps way of working, integrating your work into the CI/CD pipelines we use for testing and releases.
* Collaborate with the (international) development team on the architecture of the connector layer and contribute to the technical roadmap.
* Support troubleshooting of field issues, such as connectivity or synchronization problems with hardware.
* Build simulators for telematics hardware, so protocols, configurations, and firmware behavior can be tested without needing physical devices.
* Use AI, and work with and train models, to build simulations and test setups.
* Ensure the connector integrations are fully testable (including unit and integration tests), safeguarding the quality of the telematics integrations.


**What The Role Requires**
* Bachelor's/Master's level thinking and working ability in a technical field, e.g. Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or similar.
* Demonstrable experience with software development in C\#/.NET.
* Affinity with or experience in IoT/telematics hardware, such as GPS trackers, CAN\-bus interfaces, and sensors.
* Experience with Ruptela, Teltonika, and Digital Matter hardware is a plus.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN, LVCAN, OBD\-II, MQTT, and/or TCP/IP is a plus.
* Experience reading, configuring, or updating firmware on embedded devices is a plus.
* Experience building test or simulation tools (e.g. device or protocol simulators) and with test automation (unit/integration tests) is a plus.
* Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (incl. Azure DevOps) is a plus.
* Affinity with AI/machine learning, for example training models for simulations and test setups, is a plus.
* You're analytical and structured: you enjoy bringing order to a wide range of device configurations and documenting what you find.
* You value quality assurance and structurally build testability into your own work.
* You're proficient in English, spoken and written (the team's working language); Dutch is not required.


 Skills:\- Internet of Things (IOT), Telematics, .NET, C\#, Embedded C, CI/CD and DevOps

The company builds end\-to\-end AI solutions, including computer vision for quality and safety, custom chatbots for customer interactions, and edge AI models that run in real time on devices without relying on the cloud. Day\-to\-day tasks include assisting in building and maintaining web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, implementing RESTful APIs, and integrating front\-end interfaces with back\-end services. Responsibilities also include writing clean, documented code, contributing to basic UI/UX improvements, and following best practices for performance, security, and scalability. The intern will be expected to learn quickly, take feedback constructively, and communicate progress regularly with the distributed team.

* Candidates should possess back\-end and API skills, including RESTful API development, JSON handling, and integration with databases.
* Candidates should possess software development fundamentals such as version control (Git), debugging, testing basics, and understanding of secure coding practices.

* Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is beneficial.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, cloud or edge deployment, or interest in building AI\-enabled applications is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to manage time and tasks in a remote setup are expected.
